const clean = (s: string): string => s
	.replace(/Σ/g, 'Sum').replace(/√/g, 'sqrt')
	// Transliterasi huruf non-WinAnsi (Turki, Slavia) agar nama penulis tetap utuh.
	.replace(/İ/g, 'I').replace(/ı/g, 'i').replace(/Ž/g, 'Z').replace(/ž/g, 'z')
	.replace(/Đ/g, 'D').replace(/đ/g, 'd').replace(/ğ/g, 'g').replace(/Ğ/g, 'G')
	.replace(/ş/g, 's').replace(/Ş/g, 'S').replace(/[ćč]/g, 'c').replace(/[ĆČ]/g, 'C')
	.replace(/[šŠ]/g, (m) => (m === 'š' ? 's' : 'S'))
